subject.title: [Feature]: Configurable batching/aggregation of outbound Telegram notifications

question: Should OpenClaw add opt-in outbound Telegram notification digests, and should the owner be the Telegram plugin, shared channel delivery, or an external plugin/API seam?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the correct contract affects config shape, delivery timing, urgent error bypass, media/thread semantics, persistence, and the core-versus-plugin boundary.

options.title: Define durable opt-in digest policy
options.body: Choose the owner seam, config names, bypass rules, and durable flush behavior before implementation.

options.title: Expose an extension seam instead
options.body: Keep core and bundled Telegram behavior immediate while documenting the plugin/API hook needed for external digesting.

options.title: Keep immediate delivery only
options.body: Treat streaming coalescing, throttling, and error cooldowns as the supported anti-spam mechanisms and close or narrow this request later.

recommendation.title: Define durable opt-in digest policy
recommendation.body: Choose the owner seam, config names, bypass rules, and durable flush behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across Telegram outbound delivery and shared channel send surfaces.
